lines.en: label halloweenayane2:
: You made it how many years into the loop?
scene ayanemayahallyeah1
: I think it’s like...five? Four maybe? I’d have to ask Sensei. But even then, he always talks about how it all just blurs together. I’m kind of starting to see where he’s coming from too.
: I guess it really is him then. That’s further than I’ve ever heard of at least. None of the imposters have ever made it past the fourth.
scene ayanemayahallyeah2
: The fourth? But my Maya told me the record was two.
: Then either your Maya was wrong, lying, or hadn’t learned enough yet. But I’m going to hope that last part isn’t accurate as it would imply the timeline you come from is not the one that ends this.
: I think. I’m not sure. Time is weird. But my record is four.
: And what happened in that loop? Do you remember? Or is that like a gajillion years in the past by now?
scene ayanemayahallyeah3
: That one was odd. I’m not sure Sensei ever really left his house. But I remember Ami always being kind of pissed off too, so I doubt it was because he was too busy screwing her.
scene ayanemayahallyeah4
: Watch out for her, by the way. She tends to kill people when she doesn’t get what she wants.
: Yeah...my Maya already told me about that. But...I don’t know.
: Like, I’m not saying she was lying. I think my Maya genuinely did see something like that. But...I think the Ami from my Kumon-mi might be different.
: And if I had a dollar for every time I thought that, I’d be able to buy every melon bread in the city.
: You’d need to convert all those dollars to yen first. And the exchange fees can get pretty high in some places.
: Okay, so I’d be able to buy most of the melon bread in the city. The fact remains — you shouldn’t ever trust her. And you shouldn’t ever trust me either.
: I’m extremely selfish and won’t hesitate to throw you under the bus for my own personal gain.
: And you’re just going to flat out admit that?
scene ayanemayahallyeah5
: That actually felt pretty good to get off my chest.
: Well, I’m glad you feel good at least. Because finding out there is literally no one for me to trust back home except Sensei isn’t really a great motivator for continuing my journey through time.
scene ayanemayahallyeah6
: It isn’t my job to motivate you. It’s my job to fill you in on as much as I possibly can while I can in the event that you do get sent back.
: And seeing as you’ve managed to make it all the way here, I have no reason to doubt that you’re almost as big of a player in this as I am. But your Maya probably won’t think that.
scene ayanemayahallyeah7
: I’m stubborn. And I doubt I’d have an easy time just accepting that someone like you could be dragged into this out of nowhere.
: The only reason I can do that here is because you effectively just climbed out of a time machine in front of me.
: Well, it’s definitely true that my Maya didn’t immediately accept me. She thought I must have been pregnant or something since she and Sensei were the only ones that ever made it to the roof.

: Yeah, that sounds about right. So forget everything she ever said to you. Also, please stop subtly reminding me that you’re actively sleeping with the man I love or I am going to subtly strangle you to death.
: This has to get easier eventually, doesn’t it?
scene ayanemayahallyeah8
: What part exactly?
: I don’t know...accepting that this is the way things are? It’s a lot to shoulder all by yourself. I have no idea how you managed to keep it together for as long as you did.
: I didn’t.
scene ayanemayahallyeah9
: You didn’t?
: Absolutely not. Do you think I would have fucked so many Senseis to death if I was emotionally stable the whole time? Hell no. I’ve made more mistakes than I can even count.
scene ayanemayahallyeah10
: I’m also pretty sure I literally strangled one to death in the middle of an orgasm once. But that one was really vulgar so he had it coming.
: I’m...surprised you even had the strength to do that.
: Rope helps. Anyway, that’s beside the point.
: Well, what is the point? Because now it just feels like you subtly bragging to me about having sex with the man I love.
scene ayanemayahallyeah11
: I guess in a sense I am.
: Why are you smiling? My Maya doesn’t smile.
: She does when she feels safe. I imagine she just never felt that way with you looming over her shoulder, threatening to take away the role she spent countless years getting comfortable in.
: It’s nothing personal. So allow me to apologize on her-slash-my behalf now. I’m a very, very selfish girl. And I’ve seen what happens in worlds where Ayane Amamiya gets her wish.
scene ayanemayahallyeah12
: You have?
: I have.
: Well...what wish? Because I have a lot. Do Sensei and I get married? Do we have kids? How many? If the record is four loops, that should be time for at least two and-
: You never get married. You’re still in high school at the end of the day.
scene ayanemayahallyeah13
: And while I’ve never personally seen your body become infested with the life-ending parasite known as a “human child,” I wouldn’t be surprised if it happened.
: I’ve watched the two of you fall hopelessly in love more times than I can count.
scene ayanemayahallyeah14
: But, then again, none of those instances were with the real Sensei. So I guess your “love” is just not nearly as real and unbending as mine.
: Which one of us has had world-ending sex with fake Senseis again?
scene ayanemayahallyeah15
: Me, obviously. But you’ve collectively screwed more of them than I have. I’m just better at it.
scene ayanemayahallyeah16
: Ew...I feel super gross all of a sudden. I really wish you hadn’t told me that.
: The shame will be short-lived, don’t worry. Or at least it is for me as I’ve decided it’s acceptable to blame one’s temporary uncharacteristic behavior on just what we have to go through here.
: Cheating on your significant other with someone wearing their skin is more forgivable than someone who isn’t, right?
scene ayanemayahallyeah17
: I guess so. So I’ll just tell Sensei that his Maya approves him screwing the new Maya clone and we can all live happily ever after.
: I take it back. All cheating is bad. And I will spend the next thousand years repenting for my transgressions.
scene ayanemayahallyeah18
scene ayanemayahallyeah19
: Pfft!
: Hahah! Hahahah!...
: Heh...hahah...heh...
scene ayanemayahallyeah20
: I wish...
: I wish we got to laugh like this before you went away.
: Yeah...
scene black
: Maybe one day we’ll be able to...
: Without feeling like the world’s about to end.
scene ayanemayahallyeah21
: Oh, we got so caught up in talking about our pasts that I forgot to ask. Just what are we doing here exactly?
: Looking for something that might help.
: And we’re looking in an...empty classroom?
: Do you not see me fumbling through this locker right now? Just trust me, okay?
scene ayanemayahallyeah22
: But you literally just told me not to trust you like five minutes ago.
: No, I told you not to trust the other me. This me you can trust because this me believes you. Which is the reason I brought you here in the first place.
: But where is here? What are you looking for?
scene ayanemayahallyeah23
: Notes.
scene ayanemayahallyeah24
: I don’t think now is the time to be studying, Maya.
: Shut up. Surely you know that’s not what I’m talking about. I’m looking for my notes — on time, resets, and the like. I’ve been collecting them for as long as I’ve been here.
scene ayanemayahallyeah25
: Yeah, I’m not really sure if I want to wait around while you read through an eternity’s worth of notes. That sounds like it could take a while.
: Maybe, if I had the organizational skills of a child. But I’m sure I have some sort of...emergency instructional book somewhere. That sounds like a thing I’d have probably made by now.
scene ayanemayahallyeah26
: Instructions?! You made instructions for this?! That’s great! We-
: Don’t jump for joy just yet. I still haven’t found anything and-
: Oh. Oh, never mind. There it is. I put it right where I figured I would.
: Well, hurry up and read it then! I want to go home!
: Again, no jumping for joy. I can’t remember the last time I opened this book and, even if I could, it’s all just speculation anyway. It’s not like I know how to fix this.
: And, for all I know, we might not even be able to.
scene ayanemayahallyeah27
: What do you mean we might not be able to?...
scene ayanemayahallyeah28
: I mean you might be stuck here forever. Has that part really not settled in yet? I thought we were on the same page there.
scene ayanemayahallyeah29

: No, Maya! I guess that hadn’t settled in yet! I’ve been too busy trying to stay optimistic since that’s the only way I’ve learned how to cope with the never-ending tragedy that comes with being a perpetual teenager!
: Okay, well then you definitely don’t want to know what was in my “emergency instructions” book just now.
: What’s that supposed to mean?! What did it say?!
: You really don’t want to know, Ayane.
: So you can keep a bunch of secret notes on how to fix the world, but you won’t even tell me what they say?! What happened to filling me in on as much as you can while you can?! What changed?!

: You just want me here forever, don’t you?! I bet your “notes” said you wouldn’t be able to come! And you can’t stand that I’d get to go back to the person you’ve been chasing after forever while you stay here!
: That’s what it is, isn’t it?! You’re holding me back again! Just like you used to whenever I tried to help! Nothing’s changed! You’re still the same selfish, clingy bitch you’ve always-
scene ayanemayahallyeah30
scene ayanemayahallyeah31
: Ow! What the hell, Maya?!
: Are you done yet? Or will yelling at me for a little while longer help get all of this out of your system?
scene ayanemayahallyeah32
: I’m sorry...I just...I got my hopes up when I heard you’d prepared for this. That’s all.
: Well, I warned you not to jump for joy. And it turns out that doing so was the correct move, even if the end result didn’t really change.
: I take it that means...even older Maya didn’t know what to do for a case like this then?
scene ayanemayahallyeah33
: Ayane, I’ve been writing everything down for so long that it’s rare for me to remember any of it. It’s practically just a formality at this point. Or something to read when I get bored.
: The initial idea was to chronicle everything. To keep a log of what happens and when. Of who does what in which loop since I figured knowing this would help. And maybe one day it will.
: That’s why I came here. I wanted today to be that day. But I know now that it’s not going to be since...there was nothing in that book yet.
scene ayanemayahallyeah34
: N...Nothing?...
: Nothing. So either I’d never gotten around to recording anything or past-Maya thought this would be a funny joke. And it’s not. So I’m still not funny all this time later.
: ...You’re kidding.
: I’m not. But again, I’m not funny. So you probably wouldn’t even know if I was.
: So you brought me over here...to open up a blank notebook...and tell me I’m screwed?
scene ayanemayahallyeah35
: I mean...that wasn’t the intention. But yeah, I guess that’s kind of what happened.
: I don’t believe this...
: We can keep looking, Ayane. I’ve been hiding things in here forever. There’s a room in the basement I keep all of the older stuff in. Maybe there’s something in there that can help?
: You don’t know?...
scene ayanemayahallyeah36
: What- do you remember everything you’ve ever written down? Because, even if by some stretch you do, multiply that by a trillion and then try.
: The human mind can only hold so much information. And with limited space for memories, I need to be forgiven for not holding onto every single one of them.
: But this isn’t a memory we’re talking about...this is my ticket out of here...
: And why is that a thing I would have? I’d obviously have escaped by now if I knew how, Ayane. And while I’m very sorry the first book I opened didn’t have the answer, maybe there’s...one that will?
: I think you’re going to have to hit me again because I am about to say some very mean things to you.
scene ayanemayahallyeah37
: I’m sorry, okay?...
: Maybe I just...put that book there so I could write something in it once I knew? But the fact that there’s nothing just-
: It means you’ve never learned anything...
: You don’t know what to do...
: And I really might actually be stuck here.
scene ayanemayahallyeah38
: We...We won’t know that for sure until the next reset comes. I still think that’s your best bet in terms of “escaping.”
: But then we won’t be leaving together...
scene ayanemayahallyeah39
: Probably not...no.
: Hah...
: I’m sorry for raising my voice...I’m just really scared of...
: You know...
: Yeah...
scene ayanemayahallyeah40
: Maya? What are you-
scene ayanemayahallyeah27
: There’s something in here I want you to hold onto...in the event that you do return to your timeline. But it’s not for you to keep, do you understand? You need to give it to me when you get there.
: If you do that, I’ll know that I can trust you.
: But...But is that even possible? Bringing physical objects from one timeline to another?
: Hell if I know. Everything I do is a shot in the dark at this point. But there’s only one way of finding out, and this thing has done nothing but collect dust for years now.
scene ayanemayahallyeah41
: Here.
: This is...
: Your...scarf?...
: I take it you’ve already seen it then?
: Yeah...Sensei bought this for you. You treasure it. You can’t just...give it to me. It’s too important.
: That’s exactly why I’m giving it to you.
scene ayanemayahallyeah42
: But it might not even work! And on the off chance it does, I doubt the Maya in my timeline even knows about it! It’s spring there! She hasn’t been around for a winter yet!
: That’s precisely why you need to-
scene ayanemayahallyeah43
: Wait, spring? You guys have spring there?
: Oh, yeah. I guess you weren’t ever around for that.
: What’s the weather like? Have the cherry blossoms started blooming yet?
: It’s nice. And I haven’t seen any yet, but there aren’t really a lot of places to see them in- is that really important right now?
scene ayanemayahallyeah44
: Oh, sorry. No. Just...give this to that other me if you manage to bring it back.
: I’m sure it sounds like something out of a movie, but this might be the “shock” I need to pull me back to reality. Better than just letting my clone continue to fuck my boyfriend at least.
: Do you really think it’ll work?
: Probably not, but it’s worth a shot. And it’ll get me to like you a whole lot more too.
: Are you saying my Maya doesn’t like me?
: Probably not, to be honest. I tend to block out everyone who isn’t Sensei or Ami.

: Why Ami though? If you’ve seen her at her worst so many times and...have literally witnessed her kill people...how is she closer to your heart than me? I’ve always liked you, Maya. Even before you were you.
: Just take the fucking scarf, okay? We have like six million boxes to go through and it’s only a matter of time until people start calling us to ask where we are.
: What’ll we tell them when they do?
: Whatever you want. I really don’t care.
scene black
: Then I’m telling them we’re on a date.
: Ew. Why that?
: Because we make a good couple, obviously. And no one will ask any questions if they think we’re spending a passionate night of-
: Ouch! Maya! Did you really have to hit me again?!
: Just take the damn scarf!
